originalReview.notes: Full native1202x850modern photograph inspected. Main hall has orange grooved double eaves, strong red swallowtail ends, central seven-tier pagoda and paired gold cylinders; blue/green ridge bands, gray cylindrical/coiled-dragon columns, dark wood lattice openings and a raised granite DanChi platform with flanking stairs. Lower side wings visible. Creator’s overlaid color swatches obscure some central openings; those swatches, tourists/calligraphy and source pixels are not reproduced. The catalog1879creation field describes temple history, not a claimed photograph date.
